quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Calamity pass reflecting temporary Gate 6 cash flow depression from peak $4.5B-$5.0B/year capex on 300mm fabs (Sherman TX, Lehi UT) during cyclical semiconductor destocking. Operating ROIC normalized to 29.0% reflecting 10-year median GAAP ROIC (29.03%) and physical capital efficiency across 80,000+ catalog analog parts, while recognizing that trough ROIC (~19-20%) is temporarily depressed by fab construction. Balance sheet carries $3.23B cash vs $13.55B LT debt (2.71x net debt/NI), with organic dividend coverage protected by post-Elliott capex moderation to $2.0B-$3.0B in 2026-2027 and $1.6B CHIPS Act grants. Forward 5-10Y through-the-cycle Owner EPS growth of 7.5% driven by 4.5% analog/embedded volume, 0.5% pricing, 1.5% structural 300mm cost advantage (40% unpackaged die cost savings) and FCF recovery, plus 1.0% net share repurchases. At $302.02 (31.97x peak Owner EPS of $9.4482), TXN trades Above PAR (+41.2% vs fundamental PAR Value of $213.91 and exceeding its 5-year cycle high multiple of 29.64x), offering a 2.1% 5Y expected IRR.
